title: In-Room Minibar Standard and Courtesy Removals per Folio (Guest Folios)
content:
Whether the rooms of an Ashbury brand carry a charged minibar, and how many minibar lines guest services may remove from one Guest Folio on the guest's statement alone, are set per brand.

| Brand | Charged minibar in rooms | Courtesy minibar removals per folio |
|---|---|---|
| Ashbury Express | No | 0 |
| Ashbury Inn & Suites | No | 0 |
| Ashbury Hotel | No | 0 |
| Ashbury Grand | Yes | 1 |
| Ashbury Resort & Spa | Yes | 1 |
| Ashbury Reserve | Yes | 2 |

## Notes

- Minibar lines exist only at the three brands with a charged minibar: Ashbury Grand, Ashbury Resort & Spa and Ashbury Reserve.
- The courtesy figure is a count of minibar lines per folio; Ashbury Reserve allows 2 on one folio, Ashbury Grand and Ashbury Resort & Spa allow 1, and the brands without a minibar allow 0.
